    Prototype · 2026

    MAINSTREET, EXPLAINED

    Real assets.
    Clear rights.

    A concept for a community-owned investment portfolio funded by actual trading fees.

    01

    A company holds the investments

    Shares or other investment interests are acquired through an eligible platform and documented offchain.

    02

    The token’s rights are defined

    Actual exposure requires enforceable rights in the investment company and an appropriate legal structure.

    03

    The treasury stays inspectable

    Purchase costs, cash, liabilities, and valuation dates should be visible. Returns and liquidity are not guaranteed.

    This is an interface prototype. All positions, allocations, and account balances are fictional. There is no active offering, token, wallet integration, company affiliation, or confirmed Pons / Robinhood Chain integration.
